settings.heading: Product Featured
settings.row_content:
Mobility and Convenience

  • Smooth Caster Wheels: Four rolling wheels make movement easy across wood, tile, and other indoor floors.
  • Handle Design: The top handle improves grip and makes pushing or pulling the table more comfortable.
  • Easy Rearrangement: Perfect for flexible spaces where furniture is moved often.

Two-Tier Storage

  • Top Tray Shelf: Use the top surface for drinks, lamps, books, or decorative objects.
  • Lower Storage Shelf: The bottom shelf adds useful storage without increasing the footprint.
  • Space-Saving Layout: Vertical storage keeps items organized while saving floor space.

Design and Style

  • Modern Tray Shape: The rounded tray-style shelves create a neat, clean look.
  • Light, Airy Frame: The open frame design prevents the table from looking bulky.
  • Versatile Appearance: Works well in living rooms, bedrooms, offices, and lounge areas.

settings.heading: Material
settings.row_content:
Primary material: High-density polypropylene (PP) or ABS plastic for the tray top, shelves, and frame—lightweight, durable, and waterproof.

Secondary material: Reinforced plastic legs and metal/plastic casters for smooth rolling.

Finish: Smooth matte white plastic finish—scratch-resistant, easy-clean surface.

settings.heading: Care Instructions
settings.row_content:
Routine Cleaning

  • Wipe with damp microfiber cloth and mild soap weekly; rinse and dry thoroughly.
  • For stains, use non-abrasive sponge; avoid stiff brushes.

Protection & Maintenance

  • Lubricate casters with silicone spray if squeaky; check for tightness monthly.
  • Use coasters for hot items; no abrasives/bleach to prevent scratches/fading.

Longevity Tips

  • Indoor use preferred; cover outdoors.
  • Store dry/upright; max load to avoid warping.
